Start from a decision

A store manager might ask which month had the most recorded sales. Define the audience, date range, unit, and comparison before aggregating. If the dataset has no reliable currency metadata, describe values in recorded units.

Write a metric definition

For this guide, usable recorded sales means the sum of readable totals plus totals recovered from readable quantity and unit price. Monthly sales also require a readable date. Define those rules so someone else can reproduce the result.
